pages.overview_desc: Xaalad toos ah, shidaal, cillado, iyo xidhiidhada degdegga ah ee waddooyinkaaga, scorecard iyo digniino.
pages.cost_per_mile_desc: Qiimaha hawlgalka mil kasta gaari kasta, oo laga xisaabiyay xog gelinta shidaalkaaga iyo qoraallada odometer.
pages.role_perms_desc_short: Go'aan ka gaar waxa door kasta loo ogol yahay inuu sameeyo. Isbedelladu waxay dhacaan markii xiga ee bogga uu shubmo.
pages.role_perms_desc_long: Go'aan ka gaar waxa door kasta loo ogol yahay. Bedel ogolaansho si ay u saameyso dhammaan kuwa doorkaas leh; ogolaansho shirkad ahaan sidoo kale waa la taageeraa.
pages.coaching_desc_short: Hawlaha tababarka oo otomaatig ah oo ay kicisaan scorecards-ka badbaadada ama dhacdooyin aan badbaadada ahayn.
pages.coaching_desc_long: Hawlaha tababarka oo otomaatig ah. U habee sharciyo iyo mowduucyo, ka dibna eeg hawlaha sii kororaya.
pages.coaching_desc_default: Hawlaha tababarka oo otomaatig ah. Darawalladu waxay ku xaqiijiyaan Telegram ama halkan.
pages.audit_log_desc: Isbedel kasta oo akoonkaaga — yaa, maxay sameeyeen iyo goorma. Waxtar u leh u-hoggaansanaanta.
pages.cameras_desc_short: Hubinta caafimaadka dashcams-ka qolka. Ogow lensiyada xidhan, isku xidhka lumey iyo kamarado wasakhayn.
pages.cameras_desc_long: Hubinta caafimaadka dashcams-ka. Riix saf si aad u aragto sawirka ugu dambeeyay.
pages.fuel_costs_desc: Diiwaan gali iibsiga shidaalka oo la soco kharashka gaari kasta. Marka lagu daro odometer waxay kicisaa warbixinta Qiimaha Mil kasta.
pages.scorecard_rules_desc: U habee sida buundooyinka darawalka loo xisaabiyo — bedel qiyamka iyo xadadka. Isbedelladu waxay shaqeeyaan markii xiga ee qiimeynta.
pages.routes_desc: Mar kale ku eeg safarka gaari kasta khariidad. Dooro gaari iyo taariikh — waxaan ku saari doonaa waddada lagu midabeeyay xawaaraha iyo joogsiyada.
pages.companies_desc: Shirkado hoose oo akoonkaaga ah — mid kasta oo leh furahiisa Samsara API. Adeegso shirkadaha si aad u xaddidid warbixinta iyo digniinaha qayb gaar ah.
pages.scheduled_reports_desc: Jadwalee iimeyl soo noqnoqonaya oo wata warbixinta aad doorato. Dooro inta jeer, saacad iyo aagga waqtiga — wakhti kasta ayaad ka bixi kartaa.
pages.settings_desc_short: Doorashooyinka akoonka, luqadda, aagga waqtiga, iyo qaabaynta bot-ka Telegram.
pages.settings_desc_long: Doorashooyinka akoonka, luqadda, aagga waqtiga iyo bot-ka Telegram. Qayb kasta oo gaar ah ayaa kaydsanaya.
pages.billing_desc_short: Maamul qorshahaaga, kala soco isticmaalka AI iyo dib u eeg taariikhda biilashada.
pages.billing_desc_long: Maamul qorshahaaga, isticmaalka AI iyo biilashada. Macaamiisha Stripe waxay kaarka cusbooneysiin karaan oo ka soo dejisan karaan inv. portalka.
pages.invites_desc: Abuur xidhiidhin hal-mar oo loogu talagalay isticmaalayaal cusub. Marka hore dooro doorka — darawallada sidoo kale hore loogu xidhi karaa lambarka gaariga.
pages.maintenance_desc: Hawlaha adeegga ee la qorsheeyey ee dhammaan gawaarida — kormeer, beddelka saliida, soo wareejinta canqawayaasha iyo wax kale.
pages.team_desc: Maamul cida helay akoonkaaga, deji doorashooyin iyo ogolaansho, oo isku xidh darawallada Telegram iyo diiwaankooda Samsara.
pages.work_hours_desc_short: Sharaxa saacadaha firfircoon doorka kasta — digniinaha way joogsadaan banaanka daaqadahaas.
pages.work_hours_desc_long: Sharaxa saacadaha firfircoon doorka kasta. Jadwalku wuxuu adeegsadaa aagga waqtiga ee akoonka.
pages.driver_pay_desc_short: Mushaharka waxqabadka: mushaharka aasaasiga ah iyo deeqo laga kasbado sharciyada scorecard.
pages.driver_pay_desc_long: Mushaharka aasaasiga ah iyo deeqo. Darawalladu waxay arki karaan paystubs-kooda Telegram ama miniapp.
pages.reports_desc: Soo deji ama jadwalee warbixinta heerka sare ee fleet — cillado, shidaal, hufnaan, caafimaadka gaariga.
pages.knowledge_desc: Dukumentiyo, hagayaal iyo talooyin si aad uga faa'iidaysato madal-fleet.
pages.chat_desc: Wax kasta waydii ku saabsan fleetka, darawalada, gawaarida ama hawlgallada — luqad caadi ah.
pages.live_map_desc: Goobaha gawaarida iyo xaalada wakhti dhabta ah. Shaandhee shirkad ama xaalad.
pages.geofences_desc: Sawir oo maamul geofences-ka kicinaya digniinaha gelitaanka, bixitaanka ama joogsiga dheer.
pages.risk_summary_desc: Profile khatar darawal kasta oo leh dhacdooyin badbaadada, taariikh tababar, iyo isbeddel muddo la doortay.
pages.inspections_desc: Kormoyaha kahor-safarka darawalka — dib u eeg PTIyada la soo gudbiyey, ansax ama calaamadi ceebaha adeegga.
pages.template_editor_desc: Wax ka beddel liiska PTI ee gawaarida iyo trailerada.

vehicle.no_engine_data.title: Xog ma jirto: Matoorka
vehicle.no_engine_data.why: Qalabku waa online — goobta iyo batteriga way yimaadaan — laakiin matoorka ma akhrinayo.
vehicle.no_engine_data.do: Xiriirka qalabka ee dekedda baaritaanka ha la hubiyo. 4truck wuxuu tusayaa waxa qalabku diro.

mileage.device_change.title: Isbeddel qalab
mileage.device_change.why: Unugkani wuxuu ka soo warramay in ka badan hal qalab telematics ah muddada. Miilasha waa la isku darayaa dhammaantood; tiirarka odometer-ku waxay muujinayaan qalabkii inta badan socday, markaa faraqaas keligiis ma le'ekaan doono wadarta.

mileage.estimated.title: Qiyaas
mileage.estimated.why: Xadka muddada ayaa ku dhacay bannaan xog la'aan ah — odometer-kiisa waxaa laga qiyaasay akhrisyada ku xiga.

mileage.catchup.title: Maalmo isu tegey
mileage.catchup.why: Odometer-ku dhowr maalmood wuu aamusay ka dibna wixii isu tegey hal akhris ku soo diray — wadarta muddadu waa sax, laakiin haddii muddadu ka bilaabato bannaankaas waxay ku dari kartaa socod hore.

mileage.partial.title: Qayb ahaan
mileage.partial.why: Taariikhda odometer-ku waxay ka bilaabmaysaa gudaha muddadan — miilasha dhabta ah ugu yaraan waa intii la muujiyay.

mileage.reset.title: Odometer dib loo bilaabay
mileage.reset.why: Odometer-ku wuu hoos u dhacay muddada dhexdeeda (qalab la beddelay ama dib loo bilaabay) — miilasha waxaa laga isku darayaa akhrisyada maalinlaha ah.

mileage.rebase.title: Odometer-ku cabbirka wuu beddelay
mileage.rebase.why: Odometer-ku wuxuu kor u boodtay muddada dhexdeeda in ka badan intii gaarigu jireed ku socon karay (isha akhriskiisa way beddelantay) — miilasha waxaa laga isku darayaa akhrisyada maalinlaha ah.

vehicle.vin_changed.title: VIN wuu beddelay: ma gaari kale baa?
vehicle.vin_changed.why: VIN wuxuu magacaabaa hal gaari oo jireed, markaa ama unugkan waxaa loo wareejiyay gaari kale, ama qalabkii waa la rogay.
vehicle.vin_changed.affects: Miilaha · Taariikhda dayactirka · Baaritaannada — dhammaantood waxaa lagu diiwaangeliyaa unugkan
vehicle.vin_changed.do: Dooro jawaabta ku habboon gaariga — "gaari isku mid ah" wuxuu hayaa hal taariikh, "gaari kale" ayaa kan cusub u kala saara diiwaan u gaar ah.

vehicle.gateway_swapped.title: Qalabka telematics waa la beddelay
vehicle.gateway_swapped.why: Lambarka taxanaha ee gateway-ga unugkan wuu beddelmay — qalabka gaariga waa la beddelay.
vehicle.gateway_swapped.affects: Akhrisyada odometer-ka, oo laga yaabo inay ka bilaabmaan lambar kale
vehicle.gateway_swapped.do: Hoos ku xaqiiji haddii beddelkaas la qorsheeyay.

vehicle.odometer_rebased.title: Odomitarku miisaan buu beddelay
vehicle.odometer_rebased.why: Odometer-ku wuxuu boodtay in ka badan intii uu gaarigu socon karay tan iyo akhriskii hore, markaa waxaa beddelmay isha akhriska ee ma aha gaariga.
vehicle.odometer_rebased.affects: Wadarta miilaha ee muddada boodka ku xeeran
vehicle.odometer_rebased.do: Hoos ku xaqiiji. Miilasha waxaa laga isku darayaa akhrisyada maalinlaha ah boodka labadiisa dhinac, markaa wadarta way sax ahaanaysaa labadaba.

vehicle.archived.title: La kaydiyay: adeeg kuma jiro
vehicle.archived.why: Gaarigan waa laga saaray akoonka, markaa waxba hoos kuma cusboonaysiinayo.
vehicle.archived.affects: Meesha · Shidaalka · DEF · Matoorka · Cilladaha — qiimayaashii ugu dambeeyay ee la helay, ee ma aha kuwa hadda
vehicle.archived.do: Taariikhdiisu way dhammaystiran tahay. Ka soo celi bogga Gawaarida haddii uu soo laabto.

vehicle.stopped_reporting.title: Wuu joojiyay soo warramista: si otomaatig ah ayaa loo saaray
vehicle.stopped_reporting.why: Gaarigu wuxuu aamusay muddo ku filan in si otomaatig ah looga saaro — taasoo macnaheedu noqon karo inuu akoonka ka baxay ama qalabkii ku jiray uu shaqo joojiyay.
vehicle.stopped_reporting.affects: Meesha · Shidaalka · DEF · Matoorka · Cilladaha — qiimayaashii ugu dambeeyay ee la helay, ee ma aha kuwa hadda
vehicle.stopped_reporting.do: Haddii gaarigu weli kuu yahay, qalabka la baaro, ka dibna ka soo celi bogga Gawaarida.

vehicle.unlinked_device.title: Qalab ayaa gudbinaya magac aan gaari lahayn
vehicle.unlinked_device.why: Waxaa imanaya xog telemetry ah oo aanay gaari diiwaangashan lahayn: lama dooran karo trigger, digniin ma abuuro, liis kastana kama muuqdo. Badanaa lambarka unug wuxuu jiraa laba jeer — mid gacanta lagu galiyay iyo mid telematics ah — resolver-kuna ma qiyaaso.
vehicle.unlinked_device.do: Fur gaariga oo dhig xiriirkiisa telematics, ama kaydi nuqulka.

labels.beacon: Halkan wax la barto ayaa jira — fur socdaalka

maintenance.bulk_add.title: Hal hawl — gawaari badan
maintenance.bulk_add.body: Hawlaha mid mid ma u dartaa? Hal hawl waxaa loo abuuri karaa gawaari badan — ama koox dhan — hal tallaabo. Ma rabtaa inaan kugu tusno hawshaada xigta?
maintenance.bulk_add.step1: Riix “New task” si foomku u furmo.
maintenance.bulk_add.step2: Calaamadee “Apply to multiple vehicles at once”.
maintenance.bulk_add.step3: Dooro gawaarida — marka hore hal ama laba ku tijaabi; isla tallaabadaasi boqol bay u shaqaysaa.
maintenance.bulk_add.step4: Dooro nooca adeegga oo riix “Create”. Hawshu waxay ku abuurmaysaa gaari kasta oo la doortay.
maintenance.bulk_add.done: Hawsha waxaa loo abuuray dhammaan gawaarida aad dooratay.
maintenance.bulk_add.commit: Tani waxay abuuri doontaa {{count}} hawlood oo dhab ah — mid gaari kasta oo la doortay. Socdaalku halkan buu ku eg yahay; “Create” riixiddu waa go'aankaaga.
maintenance.bulk_add.intro_observed_other: Waxaan arkay inaad dhawaan {{count}} hawlood mid mid u dartay. Hal hawl waxay hal mar u geli kartaa gawaari badan — ma rabtaa inaan kugu tuso hawshaada xigta?

page.description: Dhammaan socdaallada hal meel, dib loo socon karo — socdaalku wuxuu kugu dhex wadaa shaqadaada bogga dhabta ah.
page.empty: Weli socdaallo uma jiraan boggaga doorkaagu furi karo.
